description: This file defines the MainViewModel class in an Android application, managing application state, UI interactions, and communication with runtime components such as Camera, Chat, and Gateway. It uses Kotlin coroutines and flows to handle reactive data streams.

classes.name: MainViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel managing application's reactive state, interfacing with runtime components like Canvas, Chat, Gateway, and device preferences. It provides methods to update settings, handle chat sessions, and manage runtime lifecycle.

methods.name: attachRuntimeUi
methods.description: Attaches lifecycle and permission handling to the runtime's camera and SMS managers.

methods.name: setForeground
methods.description: Sets whether the app runs in foreground, updating the runtime accordingly.

methods.name: setDisplayName
methods.description: Updates the user's display name in preferences.

methods.name: setCameraEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables camera access.

methods.name: setLocationMode
methods.description: Sets the app's location mode.

methods.name: setLocationPreciseEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables precise location.

methods.name: setPreventSleep
methods.description: Prevents device sleep based on user setting.

methods.name: setManualEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables manual connection settings.

methods.name: setManualHost
methods.description: Sets manual host address.

methods.name: setManualPort
methods.description: Sets manual port number.

methods.name: setManualTls
methods.description: Enables or disables TLS for manual connection.

methods.name: setGatewayToken
methods.description: Updates the gateway authentication token.

methods.name: setGatewayBootstrapToken
methods.description: Sets bootstrap token for gateway.

methods.name: setGatewayPassword
methods.description: Sets the password for gateway connection.

methods.name: setOnboardingCompleted
methods.description: Marks onboarding as completed and initializes runtime if true.

methods.name: setCanvasDebugStatusEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables canvas debug status display.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables notification forwarding.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingMode
methods.description: Sets notification forwarding mode.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingPackagesCsv
methods.description: Sets notification forwarding package list from CSV string.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingQuietHours
methods.description: Configures quiet hours for notification forwarding.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingMaxEventsPerMinute
methods.description: Sets maximum notification forwarding events per minute.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingSessionKey
methods.description: Updates the session key for notification forwarding.

methods.name: handleAssistantLaunch
methods.description: Handles assistant launch requests, updating chat draft or auto-send.

methods.name: clearRequestedHomeDestination
methods.description: Clears current requested home navigation destination.

methods.name: clearChatDraft
methods.description: Clears current chat draft.

methods.name: clearPendingAssistantAutoSend
methods.description: Clears pending auto-send request for assistant.

methods.name: setMicEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables microphone.

methods.name: setSpeakerEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables speaker.

methods.name: refreshGatewayConnection
methods.description: Refreshes gateway connection.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects to a specified gateway endpoint.

methods.name: connect (with auth)
methods.description: Connects with gateway using tokens or password.

methods.name: connectManual
methods.description: Establishes manual connection.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects current connection.

methods.name: acceptGatewayTrustPrompt
methods.description: Accepts trust prompt for gateway.

methods.name: declineGatewayTrustPrompt
methods.description: Declines trust prompt for gateway.

methods.name: handleCanvasA2UIActionFromWebView
methods.description: Processes A2 UI actions from WebView payload.

methods.name: isTrustedCanvasActionUrl
methods.description: Checks if URL is trusted for canvas actions.

methods.name: requestCanvasRehydrate
methods.description: Requests rehydration of the canvas, optionally forcing.

methods.name: refreshHomeCanvasOverviewIfConnected
methods.description: Refreshes home canvas overview if connected.

methods.name: loadChat
methods.description: Loads a specific chat session.

methods.name: refreshChat
methods.description: Refreshes chat session.

methods.name: refreshChatSessions
methods.description: Refreshes list of chat sessions with optional limit.

methods.name: setChatThinkingLevel
methods.description: Sets the chat AI's thinking level.

methods.name: switchChatSession
methods.description: Switches active chat session.

methods.name: abortChat
methods.description: Aborts current chat.

methods.name: sendChat
methods.description: Sends a chat message with optional attachments.

methods.name: sendChatAwaitAcceptance
methods.description: Sends chat message and awaits acceptance, returning success status.
